response.what_it_is: Gasoline engine-powered livestock feed pelletizer machine
hidden_risks: Engine starting and reliability under load
Quality and durability of the internal pellet die
Drive belt alignment and tensioning durability
response.best_proof: A video demonstration of the engine starting and successfully producing feed pellets continuously.
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the gasoline engine for a generator or car engine, or misidentifying the pellet mill as a standard grain grinder.
